summary: Solid UI kit embedded sheet (`@iota-uz/sdk/solid-ui/embedded-css`): utility selectors ship at zero specificity (`:where(…)`), so a host page's own Tailwind utilities win regardless of sheet order. A plain kit `.hidden` installed after the host's `lg:block` (Lens period chip, runtime kit installer) hid the host's desktop sidebar. Lens also installs the sheet first in <head>.
